description: The app can take over audio or start playing unexpectedly, while controls, permissions, and basic playback options feel difficult to manage or restricted.
name: Unwanted playback and difficult controls

description: Songs fail to start or keep loading, including after app updates, leaving users unable to play music.
name: Songs fail to play

description: Reports of personal information being difficult to delete, unavailable features in certain regions, and other problems that do not fit the supplied issue categories.
name: Privacy, regional availability, and other concerns

description: Users report unexpected charges, continued billing after cancellation, and difficulty receiving refunds or credits for service problems.
name: Unexpected charges and refund disputes

description: Playlists, library content, search, lyrics, or other music content and features are missing or unavailable, with some users objecting to restrictions on free access.
name: Missing content and restricted music features

description: Users have trouble logging in, staying logged in, retaining liked songs, or accessing Spotify in particular locations.
name: Login and account access problems

description: Offline listening, downloaded music, storage changes, and device connections or integrations are unreliable or unavailable.
name: Offline listening and downloads fail

description: Users describe slow, unhelpful, or rude customer service, as well as limited support for particular features or regions.
name: Unhelpful customer support
